notes.title: Ver. 1.04 Now Available!
notes.content:
We have released Ver. 1.04.
This update addresses the following issues:

Bug fixes:
-Overage in the help text in the Dressing Room addressed
-Button icons no longer revert to Dualshock icons regardless of input method in certain instances
-Dualshock icons no longer display in the "Peace" Yang Skill description regardless of input method
-An issue with flame effects causing certain text to be unreadable in the Archives has been addressed (all languages but Japanese)
-Text with macrons no longer appear as full width characters for some users

Added feature:
-Settings menu added to the Title Screen

Don't forget to download the Hebijo Character Set while it is free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/925863/SENRAN_KAGURA_Burst_ReNewal__Hebijo_Character_Set/

notes.title: Ver. 1.01 Now Available!
notes.content:
We have released Ver. 1.01.
This update addresses the following issues:

Bug fixes:
-Subtitles for a portion of Homura's "Navigator" voice lines are now displaying correctly in English and French
-Unlock condition for the "Path of the Shinobi" achievement has been corrected

Issues we are looking into:
-Certain novel text scrolls too quickly to read

If you purchased the Tailor-Made Limited Edition and are unable to access the limited DLC content, please try restarting your Steam client.

We are currently looking into why users who pre-ordered the game have not received the Beautiful Something Yukata. We apologize for the delay and hope to have a solution shortly.

[quote]Here are some tips to make sure you're getting the best performance out of your PC!
[list][*]Make sure your graphics card is being fully utilized:
[list][*]Stay updated with relevant drivers from your card manufacturer's website
[*]Make sure you are using your main graphics card. Different graphics card manufacturers will have guides on how to always use your dedicated card.
[/list][*]Add SENRAN KAGURA Burst Re:Newal to the exceptions of any antivirus program:
[list][*]SKBurstReNewal.exe is the executable file you need to add.[/list]
[*]Turn off any power saving mode your computer might be using:
[list][*]Go to Control Panel\Hardware and Sound\Power Options
[*]Balanced or High Performance profiles should be chosen. Any Power Saving mode will lower game performance.[/list]
[/list][/quote]
If you have any specific questions, feel free to email support@xseedgames.com with your DxDiag output and any relevant information.
